_about: Default prompts for the ADR-0017 model contract. DATA, not code: the core never reads this file or calls a model. A host maps PdfRequest.prompt to one of these, fills {words_json} / renders PdfRequest.bbox, calls its own model, and sends the answer back as a PdfResponse. Override freely; the response SHAPE is the contract, the wording is not.

table_structure.input: PdfRequest.chunks (id, text, bbox: phrases, one id each) and PdfRequest.words (id, text, bbox in PDF points, top-left origin, chunk); optionally a render of PdfRequest.bbox
table_structure.response: PdfResponse.tables; text written by the model on a text-layer page is rejected (model_text_on_text_layer)

vision_page.input: a render of the whole page (PdfRequest.bbox = the page box)
vision_page.prompt: Transcribe this scanned page to GitHub-flavoured markdown. Copy every number, date and amount exactly as printed, in the same place; do not correct, round, reformat or complete anything. Keep headings, lists and tables. Output only the markdown.
vision_page.response: PdfResponse.markdown; checked against any OCR layer (digit bag, values, coverage 0.90 / novelty 0.08) and labelled vision_transcribed

vision_page_spanning_headers.opt_in: Not a default: a host selects it per model (PdfRequest.prompt stays "vision_page"). Measured: it made mistral-small write a digits token in place of the printed row label in every body row of a scanned table (T6), so every row was disputed and citable T6 fell from 30 cells to 0.
vision_page_spanning_headers.input: a render of the whole page (PdfRequest.bbox = the page box)
vision_page_spanning_headers.prompt: Transcribe this scanned page to GitHub-flavoured markdown. Copy every number, date and amount exactly as printed, in the same place; do not correct, round, reformat or complete anything. Keep headings, lists and tables. For a header cell that spans several columns, repeat its text as a prefix in each spanned column's header, e.g. '<axis> <range>' ("Ervaringsjaren 0-2", "Ervaringsjaren 3-5"): markdown tables cannot span. Output only the markdown.
vision_page_spanning_headers.response: PdfResponse.markdown; checked against any OCR layer (digit bag, values, coverage 0.90 / novelty 0.08) and labelled vision_transcribed

vision_region.input: a render of PdfRequest.bbox (an image region with no text layer inside)
vision_region.prompt: This image region comes from a PDF page. Decide first: does it contain printed text (words, numbers, a table)? Answer with JSON only: {"mode": "transcription", "markdown": "<the text as GitHub-flavoured markdown, exactly as printed>"} when it does, or {"mode": "description", "markdown": "<one short sentence describing it>"} when it does not (a logo, photo, signature, chart without text). When transcribing, copy every number, date and amount exactly as printed; do not correct, round, reformat or complete anything; keep tables as markdown tables. For a header cell that spans several columns, repeat its text as a prefix in each spanned column's header, e.g. '<axis> <range>' ("Ervaringsjaren 0-2", "Ervaringsjaren 3-5"): markdown tables cannot span.
vision_region.response: Parse the JSON into PdfResponse.mode + PdfResponse.markdown. If the reply is not that JSON (a model without JSON mode), send the raw reply as markdown with mode "transcription": a transcription is held to dual agreement, a description is not citable. Transcriptions fill the image unit, labelled vision_transcribed, never merged into text-layer content; two descriptions become one image_description unit.
